card.stem: The new house has a traditional cut roof pitched at 45°, an internal width of 6.0 m and high roof insulation. Insulated plasterboard with skim finish is fixed under the rafters. The external supporting wall is 400 mm concrete block with a full-fill insulated cavity. The FLOOR joists are 225 mm × 40 mm and are supported centrally on a 100 mm internal load-bearing concrete-block wall. The attic floor finish is 25 mm tongue-and-groove boards. At scale 1:10, the vertical section passes through one half of the roof, eaves to ridge, showing one external wall and one rafter length, from 500 mm below the floor joists to the ridge. Include three courses of slate at the eaves and four typical roof dimensions. Part (b) adds ventilation details at BOTH eaves and roof/ridge.
card.questionText: To scale 1:10, draw the specified vertical section through half of the traditional cut roof, from 500 mm below floor joists to ridge. Include the external wall, one rafter length, three slate courses at eaves and four typical dimensions.

rows.verbatim: Vertical section through roof structure - attic
rows.contextNote: Award the best TEN acceptable construction details only: drawing 3 plus annotation 1 for each, maximum 40. Published examples are 400 mm external wall; full-fill cavity insulation; internal/external plaster/render; cavity closer;100 mm load-bearing centre wall; wallplate; rafter; insulated slab under rafter; vertical purlin; strut/collar; breather membrane/battens; counter-battens; slates; fascia/soffit/gutter(any TWO of these for ONE 4-mark criterion); ridge board; and joist/25 mm tongue-and-groove floorboards. Other appropriate detailing is accepted. Do not require all 16 indicative criteria or count the fascia/soffit/gutter as three separate 4-mark details. Preserve the paper’s 225×40 mm FLOOR joists; the scheme’s generic 200×40 mm ceiling-joist example does not replace the printed floor specification.

Include four appropriate typical dimensions for the specified roof section. This is the published 4-mark dimension allowance, separate from construction annotations and the scale/draughting marks; no finer partial band is printed. Keep the specified 45°pitch,6.0 m internal width,400 mm wall,225×40 mm floor joists and 100 mm centre support consistent.

Scale 1:10 earns the published 4-mark scale allowance. Draughting is 4 excellent,3 good or 2 fair; use 0 if no credit. The combined selectable totals are sums of scale 0/4 and draughting 0/2/3/4, giving 0,2,3,4,6,7,8. Do not award the same presentation marks again in (b).
